You can handle this, right?|audio = Sk8P4rkProWave5.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 5 ([[The Takeover Event]], Pro)}} }} ==Description== The '''Enraged''' is an enemy that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], Basic Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a low amount of health but a quite fast speed. At later waves, it can gain various attributes that make it harder to deal with, including [[Bloated]], which doubles its health, and [[Nimble]], which doubles its speed. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Enraged''' is a humanoid with a grey skin color and dark brown torso and legs. It has a glowing red outline on its body as well as glowing light red veins on its arms and head. |Legacy |The legacy '''Enraged''' has dark red skin, black torso and legs. It has a neon red outline around its body. }} ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can be quite effective against this. **Additionally, these towers have hidden detection for when the '''Enraged''' becomes [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] on some waves, such as on Wave 14 of [[Casual Mode|Casual]] and [[intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] modes. *Area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]], [[Golden Pyromancer]], or [[Rocketeer]] can be quite useful as the '''Enraged''' spawns in hordes. *Due to their fast speed, especially with the nimble attribute, slowing towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Cryomancer]] can be quite useful. **Some of these towers could also be useful at killing the '''Enraged''', due to their high damage. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1Enraged.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Enraged.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseEnraged.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacyEnraged.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.88.0GenericThumbnail2.png|'''Enraged''' on the game thumbnail. LegacyEnragedIconIG.png|Legacy '''Enraged''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Enraged''' existed in the game's code a few years before it was properly added, although it looked different from its current appearance. **This appearance would later be added to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode as a legacy enemy. **The legacy '''Enraged''' also had more variants, these being the ''Enraged Boss'' and the ''Enraged Giant'', though they were never added as they were intended for the [[2021 PVP Maps|2021 PVP]] mode which was never released. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''3 May 2024''' -
